#pragma once
#include <memory>
#include <vector>
#include "base.hpp"
#define SHAPES_API
#define SQUARE(x) ((x) * (x))
#define MAX_SHAPES 64

namespace geo {
namespace detail { struct Impl; }

/// A shape.
class Shape {
public:
    Shape() = default;
    virtual ~Shape();
    virtual double area() const = 0;
    virtual void draw(int level) const;
    Shape& operator=(const Shape& other);
    bool operator==(const Shape& other) const;
protected:
    int id_;
    detail::Impl* impl_;
};

class Circle : public Shape, private Named {
public:
    explicit Circle(double r);
    double area() const override;
    void draw(int level) const override final;
    static Circle unit();
private:
    double radius_;
    std::vector<Point> points_;
    std::unique_ptr<Shape> child_;
    Point* origin_, *extent_;
    Point& anchor_;
    int grid_[4][4];
    unsigned flags : 3;
};

template <typename T, int N = 3>
class Array {
public:
    T& operator[](int i) { return data_[i]; }
    const T& get(int i) const;
    template <typename U> void assign(const U& u);
    int size() const { return N; }
private:
    T data_[N];
    std::vector<T> extra_;
};

template <>
class Array<bool, 1> {
    bool bit_;
};

template <typename T>
class Array<T*, 2> {
    T* ptr_;
};

template <typename Derived>
struct Crtp {
    void run() { static_cast<Derived*>(this)->step(); }
};

struct Walker : Crtp<Walker> {
    void step();
};

using ShapePtr = std::shared_ptr<Shape>;
typedef std::vector<ShapePtr> ShapeList;
typedef void (*Callback)(int, Shape*);
typedef struct { int x, y; } Coord;
enum class Color : unsigned char { Red, Green = 2, Blue };
enum { kAnon = 1, kOther };

extern const int kLimit;
constexpr int kSize = 16;
const char* const kName = "geo";

inline namespace v2 {
int version();
}

}  // namespace geo

namespace a::b::c {
struct Deep { int v; };
}

namespace {
int hidden() { return 1; }
}
